zhang2023.description: Zhang, Yuan & Lu (Zenodo 2022; ICASSP 2023) NJU auditory attention detection: two Mandarin news talkers over a loudspeaker array (14 azimuths, some moving), 21 participants x 28-32 trials; Emotiv EPOC Flex 32 ch, authors' preprocessed EEG only (1-32 Hz, 128 Hz, ICA, artefact segments spliced out of EEG and wavs together) with per-trial 16 kHz wavs, envelopes and a MATLAB table expinfo, one v7.3 .mat per participant (NJUNCA_preprocessed_arte_removed.zip, 11.0 GB) plus script.zip; shipped timing shows no envelope tracking in 17/21 (see datasets/zhang2023/notes.md); CC BY 4.0
